newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl 9-mth sales down 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl 9-mth sales down 27 pct.

text.p: Austrian steel maker VA Stahl said on Monday sales in the first nine months fell to 23.6 billion schillings ($2.2 billion) from 32.4 billion at the same time last year but reported signs the market was picking up in the fourth quarter.
"The decline in the European steel industry, first felt by VA Stahl in the second quarter, continued in the third quarter," VA Stahl said in a statement.
"(But) there are early indications -- at least in some sectors like galvanized metal and pipes -- that the market has bottomed out," it continued.
